dialogues.speaker: Elham
dialogues.text: Hello! Um... May I ask you a question?

dialogues.speaker: Elham
dialogues.text: Do you still have those special candies? You know, the ones scattered on the candy towers.

dialogues.speaker: Elham
dialogues.text: My friend got some for me, and of course, the candies taste great, but I'm really curious what the coating is made out of.

dialogues.speaker: Elham
dialogues.text: It feels so soft, but it also isn't easily damaged by distributed pressure. I was just thinking, maybe it could be used for clothing?
